[[Alo]] is often recited as a mantra. 

It is recited in a form of "alolalola....." and as such it references [[Olalo]]

It is meant as three syllables "A", "L", "O", so people whose language competence means they cannot pronounce "L" as an elongated syllable should pronounce it as a separate syllable with its own vowel. 

This is why the Japanese name [[Alo]] is Aro, but the mantra is Aruo.
